findings.problem: Since land.mjs re-applies commits, a budget record taken before landing names a commit that never reaches main. The record's provenance is false. In CI or any fresh clone, sameDependencies() cannot read the measured lockfile, so the workspace-only lockfile exemption silently stops working for the next lockfile change. It is the same class of bug M18.153 fixed for Commit cells: bookkeeping that names a sha must follow the rewrite.
findings.suggestion: In land.mjs, when a re-applied commit changes .harness/budget.json and its `commit` names a commit this landing rewrote, rewrite it to the landed sha, as fillCells does for cells.
